a: Avoid keyboard traps that prevent leaving a component.
aria-label provides accessible names when visible text is insufficient.
Skip links let keyboard users jump to main content.
Focus order should match visual reading order.
Identify errors clearly and suggest fixes.
Space touch targets to reduce mis-taps.
Announce important loading/completion states to assistive tech.
Check contrast for text and meaningful icons.
srcset and sizes serve appropriate image resolutions.
Design tokens store shared colors, spacing, and typography values.
